text_block_list.text:
In order to secure a base, we must win
the crucial race: the Challenge Cup.

The day before that race—
I arrived at the candidate site, a five-minute walk from Tracen Academy, with all my friends.
(Whooooosh......)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
This is truly the place..."

text_block_list.text:
Our...
promised land.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

Just as promised!

text_block_list.text:

Then once we haul in the materials, we can put it up in no time.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:

We won't have to worry about saying goodbye someday.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
...It'll be built, you bet it'll be built!
Right, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I've devoted everything for that very reason.
Yeah, because I've dedicated everything for this.

text_block_list.text:
Every victory, every effort
was made to secure this place. That was—

"It's not about empty ideals like prestige.
It's simply so I won't be torn apart from the friends I love."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, everyone. Don't rush in greedily.
Not yet, not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:

WOOOOOAAAAAHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: Tap?! You're the one who needs to calm down, Tap?!

text_block_list.text:
